purpose: Teach: 緑化/痙攣/嘔吐/度数/積分/水蒸気/骨髄/流暢

lines.speaker: asuka_teacher
lines.jp: 蓮さん、都市部の緑化政策研究を論文で扱いましたね
lines.en: Ren, you wrote your paper on urban green space policy, didn't you?
lines.style: Warm acknowledgment, genuinely curious. Steady eye contact. A teacher checking in, not testing. Slight upward lilt at the end—inviting confirmation.

lines.speaker: ren_uni
lines.jp: はい、てんかんによる痙攣の機序研究を論文で扱いました
lines.en: Yes, I did my research on the mechanism of seizures caused by epilepsy.
lines.style: Polite, direct, a touch careful with the correction. Even pace. Not defensive, just precise—he's clarifying what his actual work was.

lines.speaker: asuka_teacher
lines.jp: 蓮さん、抗がん剤による嘔吐対策を論文で扱いましたね
lines.en: Ren, you focused your paper on managing nausea from chemotherapy, right?
lines.style: Gentle but attentive, as if turning a page. Warm tone, unhurried. Waiting to hear what he'll say next—genuinely interested in the correction.

lines.speaker: ren_uni
lines.jp: はい、視力度数の測定法研究を論文で扱いました
lines.en: Yes, my paper was on methods for measuring refractive error in vision.
lines.style: Quiet clarification, respectful but steady. No apology in the voice—just matter-of-fact correction. Slight pause before answering, as if gathering the right words.

lines.speaker: asuka_teacher
lines.jp: 微積分の高校教育研究を論文で扱いましたね
lines.en: Your paper covered high school calculus education research, didn't it?
lines.style: Attentive, warm. Leaning slightly into the conversation. A genuine moment of connection—not rushing through the exchange.

lines.speaker: ren_uni
lines.jp: はい、温泉の水蒸気成分研究を論文で扱いました
lines.en: Actually, I researched the water vapor composition in hot springs.
lines.style: Gentle but clear correction. Calm, grounded voice. Not frustrated—just patiently redirecting. Slight warmth underneath.

lines.speaker: asuka_teacher

lines.en: Ren, your research was on the history of bone marrow transplantation, wasn't it?
lines.style: Warm, reflective tone. Unhurried, as if mulling something over. The rhythm of a teacher thinking alongside her student, not at him.

lines.speaker: ren_uni
lines.jp: はい、語学学習者の流暢性測定を論文で扱いました
lines.en: No—my research was on measuring fluency in second language learners.
lines.style: Patient, clear, a touch firmer now. Not irritated, but gently insistent on the actual facts. Steady delivery, straightforward. A quiet kind of perseverance.
